_doc: Motedis' hammer nut (Hammermutter) for its B-type 6 mm slot, M5. Also sold in M3. Motedis gives no hold.
name: slot-nut-6-motedis-m5-hammer

slot.rule: Motedis' B-type 6 mm slot (slot-6-motedis), whose nuts are Rexroth's family (its nut_family is slot-6-bosch)

thread.rule: Thread M5, sold as M4, M5

nut_kind.rule: Put in through the opening; it turns a quarter turn by itself as the screw is tightened (the page's words)

length.rule: Along the slot once turned: 5.70 on the drawing
length.source: Motedis, Hammermutter B Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BHASNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BHASNM5-Drawing.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Hammermutter-B-Typ-Nut-6-M5

width.rule: Across the slot once turned: 11.50 on the drawing
width.source: Motedis, Hammermutter B Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BHASNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BHASNM5-Drawing.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Hammermutter-B-Typ-Nut-6-M5

height.rule: The body under the lips: 3.20 on the drawing
height.source: Motedis, Hammermutter B Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BHASNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BHASNM5-Drawing.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Hammermutter-B-Typ-Nut-6-M5

tongue_width.rule: Width of the step that stands in the opening, on the drawing
tongue_width.source: Motedis, Hammermutter B Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BHASNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BHASNM5-Drawing.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Hammermutter-B-Typ-Nut-6-M5

tongue_height.rule: Height of that step, on the drawing
tongue_height.source: Motedis, Hammermutter B Typ Nut 6 M5 (S6BHASNM5), drawing https://www.motedis.com/shop/products_files/Motedis_S6BHASNM5-Drawing.pdf, product page https://www.motedis.com/de/Hammermutter-B-Typ-Nut-6-M5

nut_entry.rule: Put in through the opening anywhere along the slot

material.rule: Material as the product page names it

hold.rule: Taken as Rexroth's T-nut in a 6 mm slot (1700 N): a hammer nut has the same turned rhomboid body. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m5 thread set (ISO 898-1)
